name: z2ui5_cl_smp_app_020
why: component, not a standalone app — a confirm-dialog built through factory( i_confirm_event … ) by a parent. Started with no event, get_event() returns the empty string, which equals its (unset) cancel_event, so main( ) takes the cancel branch and calls nav_app_leave( ) immediately. The handler then correctly answers with the start page. Same in the abap original; no fix will delist this.

name: z2ui5_cl_smp_app_122
why: reads frontend device info (ls_get.S_DEVICE.SYSTEM) that only a real browser sends. The smoke run drives the handler headlessly, so S_DEVICE is absent and the sample dereferences undefined. It is the sample doing exactly its job; a headless run cannot supply the input it demonstrates.

name: z2ui5_cl_smp_app_488
why: demonstrates returning data to a CALLER (get_app_prev / r_data): s_result is only filled once a called sub-app hands data back. Started standalone there is no caller, so s_result is null when the view binds s_result-product. Same as the abap original; no fix will delist this.
